title: Smoky Spanish Chicken Empanada Snack
description: A mexican-inspired snack featuring smoky chicken, crispy empanadas, and a touch of spanish spices.
instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt, pepper, and Spanish paprika. Grill or bake until cooked through.
Cut the cooked chicken into small pieces.
Brush the empanada shells with Spanish olive oil and place on a baking sheet.
Bake the empanada shells for 5-7 minutes, or until crispy.
Assemble the empanadas by placing a few pieces of chicken onto each shell.
Drizzle with a bit of Spanish olive oil and sprinkle with salt.
Serve warm with a side of orange juice.
